author: adamdangelo
text: @naval @levie @LukeYoungblood From a technology point of view everything worked well, for the same reason email has worked in a distributed way for forever. The issue was the same downsides of decentralization from today: product iteration was too slow, and users faced more friction every step of the way.

author: adamdangelo

author: adamdangelo
text: So if the smoke-from-fireplaces diagnosis is accurate, maybe we should consider banning or limiting those in some way? It's nice to sit around the fire at Thanksgiving but not worth it if it means the whole region has to breathe bad air for the next week.

text: At the same time we are gradually becoming aware of how bad the negative health effects of bad air quality are. Even if you didn't feel especially bad due to the air quality this week, if you are around SF, it probably had a real negative effect on you. https://t.co/xurSnvPf5Z

author: adamdangelo
text: See more detail in the blog post here (13/n) https://t.co/0jo9en7s3w

author: adamdangelo
text: We expect to learn a lot from this launch and will be working hard to adapt based on these learnings, continuing toward our mission to share and grow the world's knowledge. (12/n)

author: adamdangelo
text: Finally, while there are now more options for creating subscription content, we expect the majority of Quora’s content to remain free. If monetization isn’t for you, you can keep using Quora like you always have. (11/n)

author: adamdangelo
text: We expect these features to be particularly helpful to those who have valuable knowledge to share but who do not have the large reputation needed to grow a subscriber base without the distribution provided by a platform like Quora. (10/n)

author: adamdangelo
text: 5. As usual, unlike other platforms, we give you questions to answer, to help you figure out what other people want to know about. This solves a huge problem for writers which doesn't change in the context of monetization. (9/n)

author: adamdangelo
text: 4. With creators' permission, we will predict which content access decisions will balance growing subscriptions with minimizing the amount of cases where content needs to be restricted in order to earn, although creators always retain the ability to make the final decision. (8/n)

author: adamdangelo
text: 3. We have a bundle called Quora+ that creators can optionally participate in, so that they can make money from people who would be deterred by the friction of a one-off monthly fee, or for creators who don't want to be on the hook to write more every day or every week. (7/n)

author: adamdangelo
text: 2. Space subscribers will be publicly visible, which means they get recognized for funding a creator, and others can inform their decision about what to subscribe to based on existing subscribers they trust (kind of like how Twitter was better than RSS readers in this way). (6/n)

author: adamdangelo
text: 1. Our machine learning technology will distribute content to interested readers out of our 300M monthly unique visitors, helping creators reach an audience of millions without having to grow a following or build mailing list from scratch. (5/n)

author: adamdangelo
text: Some unique features of Quora subscriptions relative to monetizing a newsletter: (4/n)

author: adamdangelo
text: Meanwhile, as the internet has evolved, people have become increasingly willing to pay for access to content. These payments can support those who invest large amounts of time to share their knowledge, enabling higher quality content to exist. (3/n)

author: adamdangelo
text: Historically, advertising provided all of Quora’s revenue. This revenue funded the development of the platform, and we are on track to be cash flow positive from ads alone, but in most cases the economics of the ad market mean that this is not enough to support creators. (2/n)

author: adamdangelo
text: We are launching two new subscription options for Quora creators today. We want to make sharing knowledge more financially sustainable, which will in turn let people share more knowledge with the world. (1/n)
